title: Understanding the Data
text: The dataframe shows the time spent by visitors at different exhibits. Each column represents an exhibit, and the values are the time spent.

title: Identifying the Exhibits
text: The exhibits include animals like lion, tiger, cheetah, alligator, iguana, and turtle, as well as activities like train and playground.

title: Analyzing the Data
text: Consider how the data might be used in PCA to reduce dimensions or find patterns.
